source_snapshot.procedure:
【Before Test】
    1. Check that the SUT configuration (e.g., hardware, firmware, drivers, etc.) matches the specifications/recipe definition.
    2. Clear logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.).

    【During Test】
    1. plug cable to check LED status.
2. unplug cable to check LED status again.
3. change
command: ethtool -s <port> speed <speed> duplex full autoneg on

check Link LED blinking green ok when link 1G speed
check Link LED blinking orange ok when link 100M speed
check Link LED off when link off ok
check Activity LED stays solid green when linkup
check Activity LED stays off when link down/plug cable

    【After Test】
    1. Collect test results and photos, and save them to specific folders.
    2. Check if there are unexpected logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.) generate after test.

deepseek_columns.ai_commands: Operator plugs cable and visually checks LED.

historical_reviews.deepseek: NO; correctly recognizes physical cabling and visual observation but omits the speed/color matrix and recovery controls.
historical_reviews.gpt_v2: MANUAL ONLY / IMPROVED; adds exact port, 1G/100M partner, Link versus Activity states, OOB and the ambiguous final Activity wording.

original_test_intent: Visually validate BMC-port Link and Activity indicators for cable absent/link down, 1G link and 100M link while correlating each physical state with negotiated speed and reachability.
original_method: An operator plugs/unplugs the approved cable and records both LEDs at each state; an independently controlled agent applies the approved speed configuration, captures ethtool/external reachability/BMC events, and restores the original network state.
manual_activity: Cable plug/unplug and direct observation of color, blink and solid/off behavior are the core acceptance actions; machine link state cannot substitute, so MANUAL ONLY applies.
required_inputs: Port/MAC/physical-jack map and platform LED truth table
Link partner/cable supporting deliberate 1G and 100M states
Validated ethtool syntax and final speed/autoneg configuration
Owner resolution of `Activity LED stays off when link down/plug cable`
Operator camera method and independent OOB recovery
safety_requirements: Do not depend on the tested management link for control or recovery.
Bind speed changes to the approved MAC/port and confirm partner capability.
Do not claim color/blink from ethtool, ping or BMC output.
Record and restore the original speed/duplex/autoneg/link state.
No automatic retry, reboot or BMC reset after wrong LED or failed recovery.
agent_execution_scope: Validate port identity, baseline configuration, partner capability and OOB.
Apply approved 1G/100M states and capture negotiated speed/link/reachability per operator step.
Collect OS/BMC events and verify final restoration.
Organize physical media without making the visual judgment or verdict.
engineer_actions: Resolve the contradictory plugged-cable Activity statement.
Perform cable actions and visually record Link/Activity LEDs for every state.
Compare against the approved matrix and issue PASS/FAIL.

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: It correctly refuses automation but omits the source's `ethtool` speed changes and state matrix.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Retain operator-led visual testing; use validated `ethtool -s` only where supported and confirm actual negotiated state through independent telemetry.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: Cable plug/unplug, 1G green, 100M orange, link-off, Activity states and 10/10-minute fields are preserved.

modernized_recommendation.status: MANUAL VISUAL MATRIX WITH AUTOMATED TELEMETRY
modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Create synchronized per-state evidence rows containing cable/partner state, negotiated speed, reachability, Link LED and Activity LED media, then restore baseline.
modernized_recommendation.applicable_platform: Exact BMC/shared port, LED implementation and link partner.
modernized_recommendation.supported_version: Record BMC/NIC firmware, driver, ethtool and switch/partner versions.
modernized_recommendation.official_reference: Platform BMC-port LED truth table and NIC speed-configuration documentation.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds deterministic state correlation and recovery without replacing visual inspection.
modernized_recommendation.required_inputs: Resolved Activity state and LED matrix.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Image evidence may still require engineer judgment for color/blink cadence.

project_override_considerations: A project may define supported speeds and final link state, but any omission must be explicit and cannot be reported as full original matrix coverage.
expected_evidence: Port/MAC/LED specification, partner/cable capability and OOB baseline
Per-state cable action and operator-attributed Link/Activity photo/video
Per-state ethtool/IP/external reachability and BMC/OS events
Restored configuration, Tool Result and engineer verdict

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: The source says Activity LED is solid green when link up, then says it is off when link down/`plug cable`. A plugged cable may establish link up, so the final physical state is internally ambiguous and needs case-specific resolution.

blocked_analysis.analysis: Most states and manual method are clear and safe to prepare; the ambiguous Activity expectation is an engineer decision for acceptance, not a reason to misclassify the physical core as BLOCKED.

comparison_to_prior_reviews.deepseek: Keeps its manual conclusion but restores speed/color/activity coverage.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.gpt_v2: Agrees with MANUAL ONLY and adopts its OOB/state-matrix/conflict analysis.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.v3_1_improvement: Separates machine Tool Result from human LED observation and formal verdict.

review_improvement: Makes each LED state traceable and prevents an ambiguous plugged-cable expectation from being silently normalized.
independent_technical_reasoning: Physical cable state and visible color/blink are decisive, so the case remains manual. The inconsistent Activity phrase is a real source conflict but does not erase the otherwise executable state matrix.
no_automatic_retry: Do not repeat cable/speed transitions or reset networking automatically after mismatch. Restore only the approved baseline and preserve evidence.
